entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A rare aether-infused alloy native to Esper, prized for beauty and durability and fused into the bodies of Esper's inhabitants.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of Alara whose culture is inseparably linked to etherium.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard where sangrite, crystallized dragon blood, is found.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A sphinx and planeswalker said to have first created etherium.

entities.name: Sangrite
entities.description: Crystallized dragon's blood from Jund, the key component of etherium, long mistaken for the fictitious carmot.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Esper sect that sought carmot to forge etherium; slaughtered by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Codex Etherium
entities.description: A supposed map to carmot, revealed by Tezzeret to be a fraud.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker artificer who serves Nicol Bolas and massacred the Seekers of Carmot.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who fought Tezzeret over mining rights.

entities.name: Silas Renn
entities.description: Seeker-adept who survived Tezzeret's massacre by not being at the Academy.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: Young human artificer, the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: Esper figure who could only show how to thin existing etherium.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that merged the shards of Alara.

events.summary: Etherium is said to have been created by the sphinx Crucius.
events.quote: Said to have been first created by the sphinx Crucius

events.summary: Tezzeret reveals that the Codex Etherium is a fraud.
events.quote: it was revealed by Tezzeret that the Codex was a fraud

events.summary: Tezzeret and Nicol Bolas fight over mining rights on an unnamed plane.
events.quote: Tezzeret and Nicol Bolas fought over mining rights on an unnamed plane

events.summary: Tezzeret returns to Esper and murders the entire Seekers sect, sparing only Silas Renn, then makes the Sanctum his fortress.
events.quote: he murdered the entire sect, eliminating the new Hieresiarch and the whole Arcane Council.

events.summary: Breya becomes the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund, replacing most of her body with it.
events.quote: The young human artificer Breya was the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund.
